blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Потому нам всем и ___ (захотеться) его слушать.
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: А через это в святочных рассказах и ___ (замечаться) большая деланность и однообразие.
exercises.why: The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "с": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "-ся" the verb встречать — встретить is used with the direct object in the Accusative case: *Вчера я встретил моего друга.* but: *Мы встретились на улице.* We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups. Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся": *Я боюсь вашего брата.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 66–67.  ·  «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "с": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "-ся" the verb встречать — встретить is used with the direct object in the Accusative case: *Вчера я…

exercises.why: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37.

exercises.q: Хорошо, — говорю, — хорошо, — очень рад в подобную глупость не ___ (мешать / мешаться).
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: Он опять ___ (встать / лечь / сесть), опять прошелся по комнате и, остановясь против двери спальни, крикнул:
exercises.why: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). Both the imperfective and perfective forms of a Russian verb are to be memorized as a pair because there are no definite rules of forming one aspect from the other one: some twin-verbs differ only by a prefix in the perfective aspect; some have other changes: читать — прочитать, получать — получить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc., etc.)» «Literally садиться means "to seat oneself". It implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"» — DLI, Lessons 42, 68. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: Он ___ (сам) надел на нее при всех за ужином богатое жемчужное ожерелье…
exercises.why: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension. 2. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension. 2.

exercises.q: Ожерелье лежало тут же на столе в ___ (футляр), — я его и подал.
exercises.why: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Ожерелье лежало тут же на ___ (стол) в футляре, — я его и подал.
exercises.why: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.why: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42.

exercises.q: «___ (каковой)! — думаю, — значит, она своего упорства не оставляет, — она таки хочет женить брата на Машеньке…
exercises.why: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57.

exercises.q: Мы, мужчины, взглянув на ___ (этот) вещь, даже подумали очень хорошо.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Но чем же вы ___ (мочь) доказать ваше мнение?
exercises.why: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense. The letter в is inserted in all present tense forms of the verb жить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense.
